entities.summary: Herbert Marcuse was a German–American philosopher, social critic, and political theorist, associated with the Frankfurt School of critical theory. He was a prominent figure in the Frankfurt-based Institute for Social Research, which later became known as the Frankfurt School. In his written works, he criticized capitalism, modern technology, Soviet Communism, and popular culture, arguing that they represent new forms of social control. Herbert Marcuse was a writers & intellectuals from Berlin (1898-07-19, Berlin–1979-07-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
